name: shutter-campus-nord
description: Shooter 3D multijugador al navegador ambientat al Campus Nord de la UPC

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @shutter/server" "npm run dev -w @shutter/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client && tsc -p tools/map-import
